item.title: Aligning place-based research with the United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples
item.description: FACETS, Volume 11, Issue , Page 1-14, January 2026. The 2007 United Nations Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples (UNDRIP) sets minimum standards for Indigenous rights that include self-determination and free, prior, and informed consent for activities in territories. item.description: FACETS, Volume 11, Issue , Page 1-17, January 2026. item.title: Navigating methodological decisions: balancing rigor and data volume of the Canadian Living Planet Index
item.description: FACETS, Volume 11, Issue , Page 1-14, January 2026.
